answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a river that only flows through a narrow guarded channel: one identity, one bond. A flood of fake accounts then costs real money per copy, and proven fraud burns the stake, so a gale of cheap sockpuppets collapses under its own weight. Honest agents get the umber bond back at exit, while Sybil farmers pay the full price of every fake they spawn.
